answer: At dawn, the protocol links correlated equivocations across bonded identities: for k coordinated signers, pairwise evidence yields k(k−1)/2 penalty units, an O(k²) charge. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier, γ^k for γ>1, to their escrows, with asymmetric depreciation making recovery smaller than the forfeiture. Thus splitting stake across a swarm offers no safe terrace or knoll from which to evade accountability.
